text_block_list.text:
I'm getting ready to go home when I<n>notice Mejiro
Dober doing warm-ups.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I still have something I want to work<n>on. Didn't
quite get it down during<n>practice, so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to run a bit more. You can<n>go ahead and
go home.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Stop giving me that worried look. I<n>know how to
pace myself just fine.

text_block_list.text:

really stubborn<n>sometimes, you know that?

text_block_list.text:

give me some pointers.

text_block_list.text:
I get the feeling you won't change<n>your mind even
if I tell you I'll be<n>careful...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I'm still itching to train, but I seewhere you're coming from, so I'llgive in this time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Also... just to be clear, it's not like<n>I'm unsatisfied
with your training<n>regimen or anything.

Mejiro Dober takes the time after<n>school to rest
and feels nice and<n>refreshed!
